sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: There are two kinds of challenges we face.
sentences.zh: 我们面临着两种挑战。

sentences.en: One kind involves a novel problem.
sentences.zh: 其中一种涉及全新的问题。

sentences.en: We don't know why we are sick.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道自己为什么生病。

sentences.en: A new disease suddenly sweeps the world, and it doesn't have a cure.
sentences.zh: 一种新疾病突然席卷全球，且无药可治。

sentences.en: Novel challenges call for discovery, invention.
sentences.zh: 新奇的挑战需要探索和发明。

sentences.en: As a species, we are very good at coming up with such discoveries.
sentences.zh: 作为物种，我们非常擅长想出这样的发现。

sentences.en: countries.
sentences.zh: 国家。

sentences.en: But many of the setbacks in our lives are not caused by such probleMs. They are caused
sentences.zh: 但我们生活中的许多挫折并非由这类问题引起。它们是由

sentences.en: by problems whose solutions were discovered a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 那些很久以前就找到解决方案的问题引起的。

sentences.en: Think about the leading causes of death
sentences.zh: 想想主要的致死原因

sentences.en: in most countries.
sentences.zh: 在大多数国家。

sentences.en: They're connected to smoking, diet, and sedentary lifestyles.
sentences.zh: 它们与吸烟、饮食和久坐的生活方式有关。

sentences.en: We know what we
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们

sentences.en: ought to do to live better.
sentences.zh: 应该怎样做才能生活得更好。

sentences.en: We should eat right and exercise, get a good night's rest, live within
sentences.zh: 我们应该饮食健康、经常锻炼、保证充足的睡眠、量入

sentences.en: our means.
sentences.zh: 为出。

sentences.en: Every year, many of us include these sorts of changes in our New Year's resolutions.
sentences.zh: 每年，我们许多人都会在新年决心里加入这些改变。

sentences.en: And every year, most of us fail to follow through for more than a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 而每年，我们大多数人都无法坚持超过几周。

sentences.en: Making a change, it
sentences.zh: 事实证明，

sentences.en: turns out, is hard.
sentences.zh: 做出改变很难。

sentences.en: And sustaining it is even harder.
sentences.zh: 而要维持改变则更难。

sentences.en: The question is, why?
sentences.zh: 问题是，为什么？

sentences.en: Some of us figure
sentences.zh: 我们中的一些人发现

sentences.en: out that we have two selves and that they are in conflict and this is a challenge we need to
sentences.zh: 自己有两个自我，它们彼此冲突，这是我们需要

sentences.en: resolve.
sentences.zh: 解决的挑战。

sentences.en: But some of us go through life without paying a lot of attention to this fact or trying
sentences.zh: 但我们中的一些人过着生活，却并没有过多关注这个事实，也没有试图

sentences.en: to find ways to overcome it.
sentences.zh: 找到克服它的方法。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, how to engineer our lives and our minds
sentences.zh: 本周的“隐藏的大脑”，探讨如何规划我们的生活和思维

sentences.en: to do what we know is good for us.
sentences.zh: 来做那些我们明知对我们有益的事。

sentences.en: Katie Milkman is a behavioral scientist at the Wharton School.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂·米尔克曼是沃顿商学院的行为科学家。

sentences.en: In her book, How to Change, she studies how we can use the mind to combat the limitations of the
sentences.zh: 在她的书《如何改变》中，她研究了我们如何利用思维来对抗思维的

sentences.en: mind.
sentences.zh: 局限性。

sentences.en: Katie Milkman, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂·米尔克曼，欢迎来到“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Katie, we're going to
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，我们将

sentences.en: tackle some of the biggest questions facing us as individuals, communities, and nations,
sentences.zh: 探讨作为个人、社群和国家所面临的一些最大问题，

sentences.en: but I want to start our conversation at a more basic level by understanding the forces within
sentences.zh: 但我想从一个更基础的层面开始我们的对话，即了解我们思维内部的那些力量，

sentences.en: our minds that make it difficult to do the things that we know are good for us.
sentences.zh: 正是这些力量使得我们很难去做那些明知对自己有益的事情。

sentences.en: These
sentences.zh: 这些

sentences.en: everyday mental limitations are the building blocks of many of the problems we confront in
sentences.zh: 日常的心理局限性，构成了我们在世界上遇到的许多问题的

sentences.en: the world.
sentences.zh: 基础。

sentences.en: I want to start with one of the most common problems, the problem of distraction.
sentences.zh: 我想从最常见的问题之一——分心问题开始。

sentences.en: We walk into a room, we can't remember why we're there.
sentences.zh: 我们走进一个房间，却想不起自己为什么在那儿。

sentences.en: We mean to make an important phone call,
sentences.zh: 我们本打算打一个重要的电话，

sentences.en: we get sidetracked.
sentences.zh: 却被别的事岔开了。

sentences.en: You once experienced a spectacular moment of distraction on a bus.
sentences.zh: 你曾在公交车上经历过一次极其离谱的分心时刻。

sentences.en: Can you tell me what happened?
sentences.zh: 能跟我讲讲发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I take the bus to work most days, and I was going to work
sentences.zh: 是的，我大多数日子都坐公交车上班，当时我正走

sentences.en: my usual route, but I had a suitcase with me because I had a trip planned.
sentences.zh: 平常的路线去上班，但我随身带了一个手提箱，因为我有旅行计划。

sentences.en: I put the suitcase
sentences.zh: 我把手提箱

sentences.en: up on the side of the bus when I got in the place where you can place your luggage.
sentences.zh: 放到了公交车上放置行李的地方。

sentences.en: I took my seat
sentences.zh: 我找了个座位坐下，

sentences.en: and then I got off the bus as usual at my stop and I forgot to grab my suitcase.
sentences.zh: 然后像往常一样在我的站下车，却忘了拿手提箱。

sentences.en: My computer was in
sentences.zh: 我的电脑就在

sentences.en: it.
sentences.zh: 里面。

sentences.en: Lots of things I needed for the trip I was about to take were in it.
sentences.zh: 我即将进行的旅行所需的许多东西都在里面。

sentences.en: I had to go into Wharton
sentences.zh: 我得去沃顿

sentences.en: and teach my MBA class.
sentences.zh: 给我的MBA班级上课。

sentences.en: So I didn't really have a lot of time to deal with the disaster.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的没有太多时间来处理这场灾难。

sentences.en: And I will
sentences.zh: 我必须

sentences.en: just say my husband is my hero.
sentences.zh: 说我丈夫是我的英雄。

sentences.en: I called him.
sentences.zh: 我给他打了电话。

sentences.en: I told him what had happened.
sentences.zh: 我把发生的事情告诉了他。

sentences.en: He went and stood on
sentences.zh: 他跑去站在

sentences.en: the bus route.
sentences.zh: 公交路线上。

sentences.en: It was a bus loop around the city and he intercepted every bus that stopped until he
sentences.zh: 那是环城公交路线，他拦下了每一辆停靠的公交车，直到

sentences.en: found the one with my suitcase.
sentences.zh: 找到装着我手提箱的那辆。

sentences.en: So I do have the world's most amazing spouse.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的拥有世界上最棒的配偶。

sentences.en: You know, the story
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个故事本身

sentences.en: itself is so revealing, Katie, because it describes something that I think happens to all of us.
sentences.zh: 就极具启发性，凯蒂，因为它描述了一件我认为我们所有人都会经历的事情。

sentences.en: I
sentences.zh: 我

sentences.en: feel like, you know, on a routine basis, I open my email to send a note to my friend.
sentences.zh: 觉得，你知道，我经常会为了给朋友发信息而打开邮箱。

sentences.en: But when I
sentences.zh: 但当我

sentences.en: open my email, I see an urgent email from someone else.
sentences.zh: 打开邮箱时，我看到了其他人发来的紧急邮件。

sentences.en: And answering that email requires me to go
sentences.zh: 而回复那封邮件需要我去

sentences.en: up a study, and 45 minutes later, I look up and realize I haven't sent that note to my friend.
sentences.zh: 查阅资料，45分钟后，我抬起头才意识到我还没给朋友发那条消息。

sentences.en: Does something like that happen to you all the time too?
sentences.zh: 类似的事情是不是也经常发生在你身上？

sentences.en: All the time.
sentences.zh: 经常。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So being distracted is one pitfall.
sentences.zh: 所以分心是一个陷阱。

sentences.en: I want to talk about another, which is being impulsive.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈另一个，那就是冲动。

sentences.en: We often make decisions quickly and then regret them later on.
sentences.zh: 我们经常快速做出决定，随后又感到后悔。

sentences.en: I'm thinking of this classic scene
sentences.zh: 我想起了《宋飞传》中的那个经典场景，

sentences.en: from Seinfeld where the character George Costanza gets upset and tells his boss exactly what he
sentences.zh: 剧中角色乔治·科斯坦扎情绪失控，把对老板的真实想法

sentences.en: he thinks of him.
sentences.zh: 一股脑儿全说了出来。

sentences.en: So Katie, you once dashed off a note to a colleague because you were really upset
sentences.zh: 所以凯蒂，你曾经因为非常生气而匆忙给同事写过便条

sentences.en: And you dashed off this note somewhat impulsively.
sentences.zh: 而且你写这封信时多少有点冲动。

sentences.en: Do you remember this incident, what happened, what you said, and what the fallout was?
sentences.zh: 你还记得这件事吗？发生了什么？你说了什么？后果是什么？

sentences.en: Well, first, this has happened more than once that I sent an impulsive email.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我发冲动邮件可不止一次了。

sentences.en: But the one I had in mind was sent just a couple of weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 但我脑海里想的那封是就在几周前发出的。

sentences.en: It was a co-author team.
sentences.zh: 那是一个合著者团队。

sentences.en: Someone was inquiring about whose name will come first on this paper.
sentences.zh: 有人在打听谁的名字会在这篇论文上排第一。

sentences.en: And I wrote a hot, short email saying, obviously, the doctoral student who led this project,
sentences.zh: 我气冲冲地简短回信说，当然是领导这个项目的博士生，

sentences.en: without recognizing there were egos involved.
sentences.zh: 完全没意识到其中涉及的面子问题。

sentences.en: and maybe I should write a slightly more politic note to express why I think this is the right
sentences.zh: 或许我应该写一封稍微得体一点的信，来表达为什么我认为这是正确的

sentences.en: resolution.
sentences.zh: 解决办法。

sentences.en: It was a huge mistake.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的错误。

sentences.en: It could have been handled so much more elegantly.
sentences.zh: 本来可以处理得优雅得多。

sentences.en: It would
sentences.zh: 这本可以

sentences.en: have saved everyone time and headaches and improved relationships.
sentences.zh: 为每个人节省时间和头痛，并改善关系。

sentences.en: But sometimes we're impulsive.
sentences.zh: 但有时我们就是很冲动。

sentences.en: I have to ask, what was the fallout of it?
sentences.zh: 我不得不问，这造成的后果是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, was there any consequence to dashing
sentences.zh: 我是说，冲动发出这封信

sentences.en: off this note impulsively?
sentences.zh: 有什么后果吗？

sentences.en: Did you have to then spend time in some ways rolling back to the right
sentences.zh: 你后来是不是得花时间在某种程度上收回

sentences.en: answer?
sentences.zh: 正确的答案？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So much time rolling back.
sentences.zh: 花了好多的时间去收回。

sentences.en: So many carefully crafted apology emails to many different
sentences.zh: 给许多不同的人写了那么多精心措辞的道歉邮件，

sentences.en: people explaining, I'm so sorry, I should have explained my logic.
sentences.zh: 解释说，非常抱歉，我应该解释一下我的逻辑。

sentences.en: I should have said this.
sentences.zh: 我本该这么说的。

sentences.en: I should have picked up the phone.
sentences.zh: 我本该打个电话的。

sentences.en: It was a mess.
sentences.zh: 这真是一团糟。

sentences.en: In addition to being distracted and impulsive,
sentences.zh: 除了分心和冲动之外，

sentences.en: many of us are also just plain forgetful.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人其实也很健忘。

sentences.en: We promise to do something or be somewhere,
sentences.zh: 我们答应要做某事或去某地，

sentences.en: and then it slips our mind.
sentences.zh: 然后就抛到脑后了。

sentences.en: These self-inflicted injuries can be costly.
sentences.zh: 这些自找的麻烦代价高昂。

sentences.en: Katie remembered one time she made an appointment with an important colleague.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂记得她有一次跟一位重要的同事预约了。

sentences.en: Dean Carlin, a professor at Kellogg's School of Management at Northwestern University,
sentences.zh: 迪恩·卡林，西北大学凯洛格管理学院的教授，

sentences.en: was visiting Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 当时正在费城访问。

sentences.en: We'd made a breakfast date to get together on a Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 我们约好周一早上一起吃早餐。

sentences.en: He confirmed it on Friday beforehand.
sentences.zh: 他在之前的周五确认了。

sentences.en: I'll see you on Monday at 7.30.
sentences.zh: 周一早上7点半见。

sentences.en: He was coming right to a coffee shop down the street from my apartment.
sentences.zh: 他直接来到我公寓街头的一家咖啡馆。

sentences.en: And I got an email about 30 minutes after that date asking, you know, did one of us goof?
sentences.zh: 在那次约会大约30分钟后，我收到了一封邮件，问我是不是有人搞砸了？

sentences.en: He was trying to figure out where I was because I completely forgot and went about my morning routine as usual.
sentences.zh: 他在弄清楚我在哪儿，因为我完全忘记了，像往常一样过着早晨的例行生活。

sentences.en: And it hadn't even occurred to me that there could be something going on that was out of the ordinary that day.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都没想过那天可能会有什么不寻常的事情发生。

sentences.en: It was pretty embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 这真是太尴尬了。

sentences.en: So we've looked at the idea of being distractible, impulsive, and forgetful.
sentences.zh: 所以我们探讨了容易分心、冲动和健忘的想法。

sentences.en: For many people, another defining problem they face is the challenge of laziness.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，他们面临的另一个决定性问题就是懒惰的挑战。

sentences.en: We let the dishes pile up in the sink.
sentences.zh: 我们任由水槽里堆满盘子。

sentences.en: We ignore the leaking faucet.
sentences.zh: 我们对漏水的水龙头视而不见。

sentences.en: We tell ourselves we'll get to the gym next week.
sentences.zh: 我们告诉自己下周再去健身房。

sentences.en: And, of course, many of us are also lazy in the workplace.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们许多人在工作中也很懒惰。

sentences.en: I want to play you a clip from the movie Office Space.
sentences.zh: 我想放一段电影《办公空间》里的片段给你听。

sentences.en: Employee Peter Gibbons is asked how he spends a typical day.
sentences.zh: 员工彼得·吉布斯被问及他是如何度过典型的一天的。

sentences.en: and rather than come up with the usual bunk, he decides to tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 他没有说那些老套的废话，而是决定说实话。

sentences.en: Well, I generally come in at least 15 minutes late.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我通常会迟到至少15分钟。

sentences.en: I use the side door, that way Lumberg can't see me.
sentences.zh: 我走侧门，这样伦伯格就看不到我。

sentences.en: And after that, I just sort of space out for about an hour.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我大概会发呆一个小时左右。

sentences.en: Hey!
sentences.zh: 嘿！

sentences.en: Space out?
sentences.zh: 发呆？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I just stare at my desk.
sentences.zh: 我只是盯着我的办公桌。

sentences.en: But it looks like I'm working.
sentences.zh: 但看起来我像是在工作。

sentences.en: I do that for probably another hour after lunch, too.
sentences.zh: 午饭后我大概还会再这样干一个小时。

sentences.en: I'd say in a given week, I probably only do about 15 minutes of real, actual work.
sentences.zh: 我得说，在一个星期里，我真正投入的有效工作时间可能只有15分钟左右。

sentences.en: So, Katie, you seem like an overachiever.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，听起来你是个对自我要求极高的人。

sentences.en: I suspect that you are not prone to laziness, but does any of this ring true for you?
sentences.zh: 我猜你不太容易偷懒，但这些情况对你来说有没有一点真实感呢？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全有。

sentences.en: And I think laziness isn't always spacing out when you're sitting at your desk.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，偷懒并不总是指坐在办公桌前时走神。

sentences.en: It can also be just if there's some way that someone else, I could hand this off to them
sentences.zh: 它也可能表现为，如果有什么办法能让别人代劳

sentences.en: or I could take a shorter route to getting to my desired outcome.
sentences.zh: 或者我能用更快捷的方式达到我想要的结果。

sentences.en: In fact, the work that I did originally exploring behavior change
sentences.zh: 事实上，我最初探索行为改变的研究

sentences.en: was motivated by a challenge I had,
sentences.zh: 是由我当时面临的一个挑战引发的

sentences.en: which was that I could not motivate myself to get to the gym
sentences.zh: 那就是在经历了漫长的一天课程和研究生院生活后

sentences.en: at the end of a long day of classes and graduate school.
sentences.zh: 我怎么也提不起劲去健身房。

sentences.en: I just couldn't.
sentences.zh: 我就是做不到。

sentences.en: And so that's part of the impetus that led me to start studying this topic.
sentences.zh: 所以，这也是促使我开始研究这个课题的动力之一。

sentences.en: I want to put one last idea on the table, Katie,
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，我想提出最后一个观点

sentences.en: and this comes from the Nobel Prize-winning economist Richard Thaler.
sentences.zh: 这是由诺贝尔奖得主、经济学家理查德·塞勒提出的。

sentences.en: Many years ago,
sentences.zh: 许多年前

sentences.en: he had some guests over for dinner, and he put out a bowl of cashews as an appetizer.
sentences.zh: 他邀请了一些客人来家里吃晚饭，并作为开胃菜端出了一碗腰果。

sentences.en: Even though the guests knew that eating a lot of cashews would ruin their appetite for dinner,
sentences.zh: 尽管客人们知道吃太多腰果会破坏他们对晚餐的胃口

sentences.en: they couldn't stop themselves.
sentences.zh: 但他们还是无法控制自己。

sentences.en: How do temptations often derail us from reaching our aspirations?
sentences.zh: 诱惑是如何常常让我们偏离既定目标的？

sentences.en: Yeah, I love that story because it's one of the things that led Richard Thaler to start studying
sentences.zh: 是的，我很喜欢这个故事，因为正是这类事情启发了理查德·塞勒开始研究

sentences.en: what economists now call present bias or the tendency we have to overweight whatever will
sentences.zh: 经济学家现在所称的“当下偏误”，也就是我们在做计算和选择时

sentences.en: provide instant gratification when we're doing a calculation and choosing between options and to
sentences.zh: 倾向于过分看重能提供即时满足感的事物

sentences.en: undervalue anything that will give us long term rewards.
sentences.zh: 而低估任何能带来长期回报的事物。

sentences.en: So that tasty cashews in front of me right
sentences.zh: 所以，看着摆在我面前美味的腰果

sentences.en: now, I know the dinner will be better, but I just can't resist because the instant gratification
sentences.zh: 我知道晚饭会更好，但我就是无法抗拒，因为再吃一颗就能得到的

sentences.en: I'll get from popping one more in my mouth looms large since it's coming at this moment.
sentences.zh: 即时满足感在这一刻显得无比巨大。

sentences.en: And it's
sentences.zh: 这也

sentences.en: also what leads us not to exercise and to sit on the couch, even though we know it would be good for
sentences.zh: 正是导致我们不去锻炼、只知窝在沙发里的原因，尽管我们明知这对我们有益。

sentences.zh: 卡尔·戈德斯坦住在加利福尼亚州伯克利。

sentences.en: His teacher, Alice Shapiro, died of cancer in 1985.
sentences.zh: 他的老师爱丽丝·夏皮罗于1985年死于癌症。

sentences.en: She was 61.
sentences.zh: 她享年61岁。

sentences.en: Carl spoke and played the piano at her memorial service.
sentences.zh: 卡尔在她的追悼会上发言并弹奏了钢琴。

sentences.en: This is him performing the piece he played that day,
sentences.zh: 这是他在演奏他那天弹奏的曲子，

sentences.en: Robert Schumann's Arabesque in C major.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·舒曼的C大调阿拉伯风格曲。

sentences.en: To share a story about your unsung hero,
sentences.zh: 想要分享一段关于你的幕后英雄的故事，

sentences.en: record a voice memo on your phone
sentences.zh: 请在手机上录一段语音备忘录

sentences.en: and email it to us
sentences.zh: 并将其发电子邮件给我们

sentences.en: at myunsunghero at hiddenbrain.org
sentences.zh: 邮箱地址是 myunsunghero@hiddenbrain.org

sentences.en: Again, that email address
sentences.zh: 再重复一遍，那个邮箱地址

sentences.en: is myunsunghero at hiddenbrain.org
sentences.zh: 是 myunsunghero@hiddenbrain.org

sentences.en: You can also support our work.
sentences.zh: 你也可以支持我们的工作。

sentences.en: To do so, go to support.hiddenbrain.org
sentences.zh: 为此，请访问 support.hiddenbrain.org

sentences.en: That site again is support.hiddenbrain.org
sentences.zh: 那个网址再重复一遍是 support.hiddenbrain.org

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·韦丹塔姆。
